models.title: Bucking sawmill
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's bucking sawmill: two drag saws on a shared crankshaft, lowered and wound back up by a windlass, that cross-cut trunks into logs. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/BuckingSawmill/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Most of this model was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Its gears, saw blades, saw heads and cranks are from Immersive Woodworking's sawmill model by Bobrik00, used with permission; those parts are not covered by the repository's license.

depth.label: Saw depth
depth.hint: 0 is the top of the cycle, 1 is through the trunk at the bed

models.title: Rosser
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's rosser: a ring debarker that draws a Logging Expanded trunk lengthwise through a spinning cutter ring, whose spring-closed scraper arms ride the trunk and strip its bark. Geared feed rolls run at one speed for thin trunks and a slower one for thick, changed by the same weight that lowers the cradles. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Rosser/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Most of this model was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Its crown disc and rectifier pinions, and the tooth its other gears are built from, are from Immersive Woodworking's sawmill model by Bobrik00; those parts belong to Bobrik00 and are not covered by the repository's license.

models.title: Gear cutter
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's gear cutter, two blocks by two by two: a temporal gear master on the arbor rolls on a fixed rack while a rack-tooth cutter generates the same teeth in a steel blank beside it, and a Jonas planetary head indexes the arbor one tooth per pass. One master station takes the temporal gear (12 teeth, the size of the game's gears) or the large temporal gear (20). The feed's rectifier, clutch, worm and wheel are enclosed in the column and a gearbox with removable covers; a sight-feed drip oiler over the cutter shows the machine's oil. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/GearCutter/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. The masters wear the game's temporal gear texture.

models.title: Draw bench
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's draw bench, one block wide and four long: a chain draw bench that draws a lead or copper hollow section (the game's chute section), threaded on a mandrel, through a die into four pipe sections, a quarter of it a stroke. The dog grips each section's point at the die and an endless chain beside the bed, shackled to it, hauls it along, driven from the axle through a rectifier, a cone clutch and a two-speed change gear (copper draws at half lead's speed). Each section is handed out as its draw finishes and the jaws open, the dog knocks the clutch out at the end of its stroke, and a counterweight hauls the chain and the dog back. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/DrawBench/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Axle angle
theta.hint: Turns the entry shaft and the rectifier's gears

reverse.hint: The rectifier turns the clutch's cup the same way either way

work.label: Sections drawn
work.hint: One unit is one stroke's whole cycle: the start lever throws the clutch in and shuts the jaws, the dog draws the section, the jaws open and the section is handed out (it leaves the model), the dog knocks the clutch out, the weight hauls the dog back, and the bench waits for the next. Four sections a hollow.

models.title: Cylinder borer
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's cylinder borer, one block wide, two high and four long, after John Wilkinson's boring mill of 1775. What it bores is the cylinder of Pipes and Power Expanded's Watt and Cornish engines (their engine block's barrel: 10 voxels across, its bore 8, 16 long, a band near its top and two steam ports), cast in iron for the Watt or in steel for the Cornish, as ppex draws them. The casting, square outside as ppex draws it and with a round bore, lies on its side on two timber bearers, chained down, and a slender boring bar runs right through it, carried in a bushing at each end and turned from the axle through a pinion and a great wheel, 1:4. A cutter head keyed on the bar is drawn through the bore by a control rod from a crosshead on the bench's ways, pulled by a rope wound on a drum that a falling weight turns: a weighted feed, as Wilkinson's was. The cast skin sinks into the wall as the cutters pass, leaving the bore bright. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/CylinderBorer/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. The cylinder is drawn to the proportions of Pipes and Power Expanded's engine cylinder, in the game textures its engines wear.

work.hint: How far the cutter head has come through the bore, in blocks: from outside the drive end until the cutters are past the far end. The weight falls half as far, the crosshead and its rod come with the head, and each slice of the cast skin sinks into the wall as the cutters cross it.

presence.hint: Eases in as a cylinder is loaded, and out as it is cleared: the crosshead's handle pushes the head back, winding the weight up

oil.hint: How full the machine's oil tank is: the bushings' sight-feed cups

models.title: Squaring shear
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's squaring shear, one block wide and two long: a tinsmith's foot-treadle squaring shear of the early 1800s in oak with iron blades. A lead or copper plate lies on the table against the back gauge, the hold-down comes down on it, the treadle pulls the crosshead and its blade down through it across its middle, and the two half plates are drawn off towards the operator under the raised blade. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/SquaringShear/tools/make_shape.py.

models.title: Press brake
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's press brake, one block wide and two long: a hand-worked leaf brake (cornice brake) of the early 1800s in oak with iron wearing edges and cupronickel screws. A lead or copper half plate, cut on the squaring shear, lies across the folding edge, half on the bed and half over the leaf; its near half is clamped under a bar brought down by two screws and the leaf folds the other half up once, across its middle, into an angle with two 4-wide legs, over-bent for its spring-back, then the angle is slid off onto the leaf. Copper is screwed down harder and the leaf thrown further. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/PressBrake/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

models.title: Mandrel forging station
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's mandrel forging station, one block wide and two long: a smith's station of the 1700s, an oak stump carrying an iron mandrel in a bracket, with a small swage beside it. A lead or copper hollow section is hammered down onto the mandrel blow by blow: it closes from 8 to 6 across onto the mandrel and stretches from 8 to 16 long, evenly, into one tube, two pipe sections end to end. Or a hot steel rod laid along the mandrel is wound round it from the shoulder, a side at a time, each growing from its corner as the rod shrinks into it, into a six-turn square coil spring. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/MandrelStation/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Blows, or the held click
theta.hint: The player's right-clicks with a hammer, one turn a blow, or, for a spring, right-click held, a turn a second; this is that clock. The model is posed by the work below, which Play moves with it at a lead hollow's nine turns (in the game copper takes fourteen blows, and a spring eight turns: 1.125 RPS shows a spring at the game's pace)

reverse.label: Count backwards
reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the work only goes forward

work.label: Work
work.hint: A hollow: it closes from 8 to 6 across onto the mandrel and stretches from 8 to 16 long, evenly, into one tube, its two pipe sections end to end; at 1 it is on the mandrel and the game delivers the sections. A spring: the rod lies straight along the mandrel's top edge, the coil's length; each side grows from its corner along its own line across the face, as wire laid down, while the rod moves across that face with the growing end, its shoulder end at the bend, shrinking into the coil; so the rod goes round the mandrel a face a side, never stopping, used up from the shoulder while its far end stays put, and the coil grows from the shoulder a pitch a turn; at 1 the spring is wound, the rod gone, and the game delivers it.

size.label: Work on the mandrel
size.hint: The job, each its own class: a lead hollow (1) or a copper hollow (2), forged into two pipe sections (copper takes half as many blows again; the model moves the same), or a hot steel rod (3), wound into a spring

presence.label: Work presence
presence.hint: Eases in as the work goes on; in the game the work is no longer drawn once it is delivered

heat.hint: The steel rod is wound hot: drawn as the game draws hot metal, its glow by temperature (steel works from 751 °C, half its melting point; it glows from 525 °C, red to orange, yellow past 900 °C)

models.title: Amalgam pan
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's amalgam pan, one block: a hand-worked amalgamating pan of the mid 1800s, the Washoe process's pan scaled down. A shallow sheet-iron pan on an oak stand, a cast-iron step in its floor and a cast arch across its rim carrying the spindle; on the spindle a muller of four arms, an iron shoe under each dragging on the floor, and above the arch a crank with an oak handle. The player turns the crank and the shoes grind gold or silver concentrate into the mercury on the floor, which becomes amalgam. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/AmalgamPan/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. The mercury's texture is the mod's own (provisional).

theta.hint: The player holds right-click on the pan to turn the crank, as on the quern; this is the crank's angle. The muller and its shoes turn with it, once a turn

options.hint: A pool of mercury on the floor, the concentrate worked into it as the shoes go round.

options.label: Amalgam
options.hint: The worked charge: a grey paste of gold or silver amalgam, ready to be taken out and retorted in the still.

models.title: Handcar
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's handcar, a standard-gauge rail car for Yang's Transport Tycoon pumped by two riders: a walking beam on an A-frame rocks on its pivot, and its pitman turns a crank on a countershaft whose 24-tooth gear drives an 8-tooth pinion on the front axle, three turns of the wheels a stroke. The marked points are where the riders stand and hold the handles, and where a chest or crate goes. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Handcar/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. It wears the game's oak and copper textures.

models.title: Eidolon gantry
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's eidolon gantry, six blocks deep, five wide and five and a half high: an open timber frame in the wood it is built from (oak here), with iron plates, brackets and pegs, in which the eidolon is built stage by stage, hung limp from a hand winch at the back, geared in wood like a mill, whose chain runs over a sheave on the hoist beam and whose crank is outside the frame, on the south side; it stays as the eidolon's dock, and the front (west) is open for it to walk out of. The frame is crafted and the winch fitted onto it stage by stage, from vanilla's wooden axles and spur gears, planks, iron and chain. The chain then hangs a wooden spine by a ring over its top peg, empty; the crafted torso is placed onto it first and the body built on in layers, and when the eidolon wakes it unclamps, steps forward off it and leaves it hanging empty; it docks back onto it to have its layers stripped and refitted. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/EidolonGantry/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: The gantry, its winch and chains were made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The body hung in it and the spine it hangs from are Anego Studios' model, Vintage Story's mobile eidolon, posed in its hung animation; they are not covered by the repository's license.

The model is posed by the let-down below, which Play runs with it: the crank turns two stages of wooden mill gearing (a 6-stave lantern pinion driving a 30-cog wheel, twice: 25 to 1) to the drum, about three turns over the let-down, and the pawl is thrown off its iron ratchet as it starts

reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the let-down runs down, waits and winds back up

depth.hint: 0 is hung, the lowest toe 3 voxels off the floor; 1 is let down onto the floor. The spine comes down with the body. The eidolon wakes from 0: it unclamps from the spine and drops onto its feet

models.title: Crucible furnace
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's crucible furnace, three blocks wide, three deep and two high: one Huntsman (Sheffield) melting hole of the late nineteenth century, centred in thick walls of fired brick of any one type, lined on its hot faces with tier-3 refractory brick and bound with iron, holding two fireclay pots side by side on a grate of firebars, packed round in one bed of coke to their shoulders, under a hinged lid of firebrick in an iron frame that swings back on its top back edge to rest just past upright against two iron stops; shut, it lies flush with the floor. Natural draught only: air comes in at the ash mouth in the middle of the front, under the grate, which an iron damper slides over (open, half, shut), and leaves by a flue to an outlet in the middle of the back row, where the player stands the chimney or a flat iron cap. Built in stages: the iron frame, the brickwork, the lining, the lid and damper. Furnaces stand side by side in a row of up to five, fifteen blocks long, their plain side walls meeting, sharing one chimney. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/CrucibleFurnace/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

models.title: Ball mill
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's ball mill, three blocks long, two high and two deep: a Krupp (Gruson) ball mill of the 1890s, the ore line's continuous grinder. A short drum on a hollow trunnion and a journal, in two bearings on cast pedestals on a masonry bed, in which iron balls (not drawn) tumble over the ore and grind it; round the drum and turning with it the screens, a coarse one of perforated plate and a fine one of wire cloth, which let out only what is ground fine enough into the discharge hopper under them, and from it by the output chute. The axle drives a pinion on its own line, which turns the drum by a girth wheel at a third of the axle, whichever way. Ore comes in by a chute into the feed box at the trunnion's mouth, water by a ppex pipe beside it, and the box's spout runs into the trunnion's bore. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/BallMill/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. The chute sections are drawn as the game's own chute, the water pipe as the mod's soldered pipe.

reverse.hint: The drum is symmetric: it grinds the same either way, so there is no rectifier
